selection_rule: one frame in each previously unused hashed development scene; sort by official native timestamps, select lower middle ordinal among frames with >=3 CAV, or among all if none qualify; CPU outcomes not used; first pilot reused exactly
scope: Six independent scene directories, one sampled frame per scene. Real CPU detections under simulated network timing.
interpretation: The prior development pilot had a positive contrast and is explicit in the pooled descriptive total. Five additional frames provide a separate descriptive check. This sample cannot establish stable benefits or deployment performance.
ap_method: Pinned per-frame BEV IoU matching and globally score-sorted VOC precision-envelope AP in each cohort.
